# FileUpload

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

forms · tier 3 · beta · runs in the browser.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

To pick files for a form, by a click, a key or a drop. It is one element: a drop zone that is
a real `<input type="file">`, so it works and posts before any script runs.

```tsx
import { FileUpload } from 'topclassui'
```

```tsx
<form method="post" encType="multipart/form-data">
  <label htmlFor="attachments">Attachments</label>
  <FileUpload id="attachments" name="attachments" accept="application/pdf,image/png" maxFiles={5} maxSize={5 * 1024 * 1024}>
    PDF or PNG, up to 5 files
  </FileUpload>
</form>
```

**A name is required.** Pass `id` (for a `<label htmlFor>`), `aria-label` or
`aria-labelledby`; the type refuses an upload with none. The children are the hint inside the
zone, and describe the input: its id comes first in `aria-describedby`, then yours. A link or a
button in the hint sits over the input and takes its own click, and the zone draws its ring while
it has the keyboard; every other point of the zone opens the picker.

**Inside a Field** the control object spreads as it is: `{(control) => <FileUpload {...control} />}`.
The input then reads the zone's hint, the Field's hint and its error, in that order, and a
remove or a drop dispatches an `input` event, so a FieldLive's error goes when the list changes
(`dummy/in-field.tsx`).

**Where the props go.** `className`, `style` and `ref` reach the root `<div>`; every other prop
(`name`, `accept`, `required`, `form`, `disabled`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) reaches the input, not the
root as the table below says. `maxFiles` alone decides `multiple`: above 1 the input takes
several files at once.

**The form.** An input cannot set its form's `encType`: a form with a string `action` needs
`encType="multipart/form-data"`, or it sends only the names. Before the page hydrates the
browser posts what was picked, one part per file; an empty input sends one empty part, and
`required` on an empty one blocks the submit. Once hydrated, the input holds exactly the list
on screen: a refused file is shown with its reason and never sent.

**The limits are checked in the browser only, after hydration: check them again in the
action.** `maxFiles` (1 to 100, default 1) keeps the first files and says how many are allowed;
with 1 a new file replaces the old one. `maxSize` is in bytes (1 to 10 GiB, the default) and
refuses a larger file as too large; `accept` refuses a file it does not take, as the picker
reads it (`.pdf`, `image/*`, `application/pdf`). Each refusal is read out in a hidden status line.

**The list** adds up across picks and drops, shows each file's name and size in the reader's
digits, and has a remove button per file that reads "Remove brief.pdf". After a remove the
focus goes to the next file's button, else the previous one, else the input. It shows
`visibleRows` rows (1 to 20; left out, the `--tc-list-rows` knob) and then scrolls inside
itself. `onValueChange(files)` hears the kept files after each change.

```tsx
'use client'

export function Avatar() {
  return <FileUpload aria-label="Avatar" name="avatar" accept="image/*" onValueChange={(files) => { console.log(files[0]?.name) }} />
}
```

**A form reset**, a reset button or a React 19 form action that settles empties the list, as
the browser empties the input; it calls no `onValueChange`. A picked file cannot be set by a
page, so there is no `value`.

**A drop.** A drag of files marks the zone (`data-dragging`): the line turns solid and primary
and the zone takes the primary tint; under forced colours the line is Highlight. A drag of text
is left alone. A disabled upload takes no drop and the browser does not open the file.

**The keyboard.** Tab reaches the input, and the zone draws the ring; Enter or Space opens the
picker. Each remove button is a tab stop; the list is one only while it scrolls.

**In right-to-left** the zone centres, the rows mirror, and each file name takes its own
direction.

### What the platform gives

| The platform | Here |
|---|---|
| `<input type="file">`, the picker, Enter and Space, a drop onto the input | the input covers the zone, unseen |
| a multipart post of each file, `required`, `accept` as a hint to the picker | as they are |
| `multiple` | from `maxFiles` |
| `input.files`, which a page can only replace through a `DataTransfer` | written back after each change, then an `input` event |

No Base UI part: none takes a file.

### Not built

Upload progress and a done or failed state per file (choice 23), a separate Browse button
(choice 22), image previews, `capture`, folders, a controlled list, windowing (choice 25),
`size`, the drawn "Drop to upload" while dragging, a `showList` toggle, paste into the zone, a
check for the same file twice, an `error` status (choice 3), a skeleton.

## Import

```tsx
import { FileUpload } from 'topclassui'
```

## Props

Required: `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` or `id`. Every other prop below is optional.

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aria-label` | **yes**, or `aria-labelledby` or `id` | `string` | - | The name read out when no visible label names the control. |
| `aria-labelledby` | **yes**, or `aria-label` or `id` | `string` | - | The id of the visible text that names the control. |
| `id` | **yes**, or `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` | `string` | - | The id a `<label htmlFor>` points at. |
| `children` | no | `ReactNode` | - | The hint inside the zone, such as "PDF or PNG, up to 5 MB": it describes the input; a link in it takes its own click. |
| `className` | no | `string` | - | On the root, merged last. |
| `invalid` | no | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the files as wrong: sets aria-invalid on the input, and the line of the zone turns to danger and thickens. |
| `maxFiles` | no | `integer`, min 1, max 100 | `1` | How many files the list keeps, clamped to 1 to 100; above 1 the input takes several at once. |
| `maxSize` | no | `integer`, min 1, max 10737418240 | `10737418240` | The largest file accepted, in bytes, clamped to 1 to 10 GiB; checked in the browser only. |
| `onValueChange` | no | `((files: readonly File[]) => void)` | - | The accepted files after each pick, drop or remove. Client-only. |
| `ref` | no | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | - | The root element, a `<div>`. |
| `style` | no | `CSSProperties` | - | On the root. |
| `visibleRows` | no | `number`, min 1, max 20 | `7` | Rows the list shows before it scrolls, clamped; left out, the --tc-list-rows knob applies. |

Anything else is passed to the root element, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
